name: redminportal
description: RedminPortal is a backend administrating tool for Content Management and Ecommerce sites.
author: Redooor LLP

scripts.build:css: sass src/resources/assets/scss/redminportal.scss src/public/css/redminportal.css --style=expanded --source-map --embed-sources --fatal-deprecation=import --fatal-deprecation=color-functions --fatal-deprecation=global-builtin && postcss src/public/css/redminportal.css -o src/public/css/redminportal.css --map && node scripts/banner.mjs src/public/css/redminportal.css
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:css && npm run build:css:min && npm run build:tinymce:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:vendor
scripts.clean: rm -f src/public/css/redminportal.css src/public/css/redminportal.css.map src/public/css/redminportal.min.css src/public/css/redmin-tinymce.css src/public/css/redmin-tinymce.css.map src/public/css/redmin-tinymce.min.css src/public/js/bootstrap-tagsinput.js.map src/public/js/bootstrap-tagsinput.min.js src/public/js/bootstrap-tagsinput.min.js.map
